typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{1 Day} as string,
		{Grand Total} as string,
		{Reporting Date} as string,
		{> 25 Days} as string,
		{16 - 19 Days} as string,
		{Title (Title)} as string,
		{10 - 15 Days} as string,
		{Name of Reconciliation} as string,
		{20 - 24 Days} as string,
		Date as string,
		{2 - 5 Days} as string,
		{6 - 9 Days} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		{1_Day} as string,
		Grand_Total as string,
		Reporting_Date as string,
		__25_Days as double,
		{16_-_19_Days} as double,
		Title__Title_ as string,
		{10_-_15_Days} as double,
		Name_of_Reconciliation as string,
		{20_-_24_Days} as double,
		Date as string,
		{2_-_5_Days} as double,
		{6_-_9_Days} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		{1_Day} = {1 Day},
		Grand_Total = {Grand Total},
		Reporting_Date = {Reporting Date},
		__25_Days = {> 25 Days},
		{16_-_19_Days} = {16 - 19 Days},
		Title__Title_ = {Title (Title)},
		{10_-_15_Days} = {10 - 15 Days},
		Name_of_Reconciliation = {Name of Reconciliation},
		{20_-_24_Days} = {20 - 24 Days},
		Date,
		{2_-_5_Days} = {2 - 5 Days},
		{6_-_9_Days} = {6 - 9 Days}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
